payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_suite.py::test_the_suite_hands_revert_the_specs_own_renames stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/gates/core/revert.py. The claim was 'The gate suite hands `revert_gate` the renames of the spec it was built with. The witness builds a suite three times over one baseline whose `tests` gate collects an old name, and one head that collects the new name and passes it with the source reverted. A `CellSpec` declaring the pair and an `intake.Spec` declaring it each yield a `revert` result of `skip`. A spec declaring no renames yields `fail`, with one `passed-without-source` failure naming the new name.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_regate.py::test_regate_judges_a_witness_its_cells_revert_set_aside_and_finds_no_new_failure, tests/test_revert.py::test_a_new_test_that_passes_without_the_source_is_a_failure, tests/test_session.py::test_revert_reports_a_new_test_that_passed_without_its_source, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
